# LPM Vault

> A free, open-source macOS app for project environment variables.

LPM Vault stores secrets in the macOS Keychain. The app shows keys across environments in one matrix.
It flags missing keys and values that differ between environments. The signed LPM CLI reads the same vault.
Optional sync encrypts values on the Mac before upload. The Mac app sends no analytics.
The app requires macOS 14 or later and supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

## Product resources

- [Website](https://vault.lpm.dev/): Features, setup, and security overview.
- [Documentation](https://cli.lpm.dev/docs/dev/lpm-vault): Setup and CLI integration.
- [Security model](https://cli.lpm.dev/docs/infra/secrets-vault): Keychain storage and encrypted sync.
- [Source](https://github.com/lpm-dev/lpm-vault): Code and contribution information.
- [Releases](https://github.com/lpm-dev/lpm-vault/releases): Release notes and signed downloads.
- [Download](https://vault.lpm.dev/download): The latest Mac installer.
